# infra-spec-checks

> Declarative checks for servers and containers that verify listening ports, installed packages, running services and file modes from proc files, without a shell on the input. Gem `u954-infra-spec-checks`, module `Trysac::InfraSpecChecks`, MIT licensed, Ruby >= 4.0, standard library only.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the library and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the specs
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and known limits
